name: curation
description: Confirmations and flags on the subjects of a model's abstraction hierarchy: nets, elements, levels and relations.
author: AgenticNetOS

stores.description: Confirmations and flags, one token each, correlated by markId; a flag's status is open until it is resolved.
How an open flag was settled, correlated by markId.
Refinement passes: each records which answers and marks a pass consumed (consumedUntil), what it changed and what it asked next, so the next pass and the next focus session start from it.
What the person said about a subject in their own words (brief), what the AI understood and changed (summary), and decisions taken (decision); append-only, newest last

actions.name: confirm
actions.description: Record that the subject describes what it claims to describe, at the given revision. A markId is written once; confirm again under a new markId after a change.

subjectKey.description: session::net, session::net#elementId, a level id, or from::net>relation>to::net

revision.description: Definition revision the confirmation was given against

by.description: Who confirmed: the person, or a persona on the person's behalf

note.description: Why it is right, in the person's words when they said so

sourceHash.description: Content hash of the subject's referenced sources (documents, code, data, any file the definition names) at confirmation time, so a later change can be told from a mere re-read

actions.name: flag
actions.description: Raise a flag on the subject. It stays open until resolved. A markId is written once, so a deterministic markId makes a repeated check idempotent.

reason.description: What was measured or read that justifies the flag

evidence.description: Files, lines, numbers, or the person's words

actions.name: resolve
actions.description: Settle an open flag: say how (changed, confirmed, withdrawn). The flag's status becomes resolved; a resolved flag cannot be resolved twice.

how.description: changed: the model or its sources were corrected; confirmed: the person says the subject is right as it is; withdrawn: the flag was mistaken

actions.name: defer
actions.description: Put a subject aside until a date: the worklist and the Focus view leave it out until then. The newest defer wins; a defer in the past is over.

until.description: ISO-8601 instant after which the subject is due again

actions.name: pass
actions.description: Record a refinement pass over the model: the answers and marks up to consumedUntil were read and applied top-down, the listed changes were made, the listed questions were raised for the next focus session. One record per passId.

by.description: Who ran the pass: the client and persona, or the person

consumedUntil.description: ISO-8601 instant: every answer and mark created up to it was read by this pass

scope.description: Level, persona or net the pass was limited to, if any

changes.description: What changed: definitions revised, nets created, flags resolved, spec rebuilt

questions.description: promptIds raised for the next focus session

actions.name: note
actions.description: Record words about a subject: a brief (the person describes what the subject is and needs, in their own words; the next pass derives from it), a summary (the AI says what it understood, changed and left open), a decision, or a finding (what the code says now, written by a read-only coder). One record per noteId.

subjectKey.description: session::net, session::net#elementId, a level id, a focus scope subject (scope:<expr>@<level>), or from::net>relation>to::net

noteKind.description: brief: the person's own words; summary: the AI's understanding after a pass; decision: something settled for good; finding: what the sources say now (written by a coder reading the code)

passId.description: summary: the pass that wrote it

requestId.description: the hand-over request the pass served, if any
